failure_description: Main conveyor drive chain snapped under load
root_cause: Fatigue failure of link pins due to over-tensioning
action_plan: Replace chain and install a tension monitoring sensor

failure_description: Cooling water temperature exceeding setpoint
root_cause: Scale buildup in heat exchanger tubes reducing heat transfer
action_plan: Perform chemical descaling and increase blowdown frequency

failure_description: Intermittent signal loss from flow meter FM-201
root_cause: Corroded terminal connections in the junction box
action_plan: Clean terminals and apply dielectric grease to prevent oxidation

failure_description: Database query latency increased by 300%
root_cause: Missing index on high-traffic transaction table
action_plan: Create required database indexes and optimize slow-running queries

failure_description: Centrifuge high vibration during ramp down
root_cause: Out-of-balance condition caused by uneven cake distribution
action_plan: Adjust wash cycle parameters and inspect discharge scraper

failure_description: Hydraulic oil overheating in unit HPU-2
root_cause: Cooling fan motor failure on the oil-to-air heat exchanger
action_plan: Replace fan motor and integrate a temperature alarm into the SCADA

failure_description: PLC CPU went into STOP mode unexpectedly
root_cause: Internal power supply fluctuation caused by a failing capacitor
action_plan: Replace PLC power supply module and install a dedicated UPS

failure_description: Inconsistent product weight from filling line
root_cause: Air bubbles in the feed line due to a faulty suction seal
action_plan: Replace suction line gaskets and install an air eliminator

failure_description: Server RAID array reported multiple disk failures
root_cause: Backplane vibration from nearby heavy machinery
action_plan: Install vibration isolation mounts for the server rack and replace disks

failure_description: Valve actuator failing to reach full travel
root_cause: Internal spring breakage due to corrosion from moist instrument air
action_plan: Replace actuator spring and upgrade the instrument air dryer system

failure_description: Electric motor noise on compressor C-12
root_cause: Lack of grease in the non-drive end bearing
action_plan: Implement an ultrasonic-assisted lubrication program

failure_description: Erratic readings from pressure transmitter PT-40
root_cause: Ground loop interference from shared power supply
action_plan: Install a signal isolator and ensure single-point grounding

failure_description: Boiler trip due to low water level false alarm
root_cause: Fouling on the level probe surfaces causing false conductivity
action_plan: Clean level probes weekly and implement a redundant ultrasonic sensor

failure_description: Application crash on operator workstation
root_cause: Corrupted graphics driver after an unverified OS update
action_plan: Roll back graphics driver and disable automatic OS updates on critical units

failure_description: Leaking mechanical seal on centrifugal pump
root_cause: Dry running caused by temporary loss of suction head
action_plan: Install a dry-run protection switch and verify suction line integrity

failure_description: Transformer humming louder than normal
root_cause: Loose core laminations due to age and thermal cycling
action_plan: Perform a dissolved gas analysis (DGA) and plan for core tightening

failure_description: Slow response of temperature control loop
root_cause: PID parameters poorly tuned for the current production rate
action_plan: Perform auto-tuning of the PID loop during a steady-state run

failure_description: Network latency spikes in the manufacturing VLAN
root_cause: Broadcast storm caused by a faulty network switch
action_plan: Identify and replace the faulty switch and enable storm control

failure_description: Steam pipe hammering during startup
root_cause: Condensate accumulation due to a blocked steam trap
action_plan: Clear the steam trap and revise the startup SOP for manual draining

failure_description: Drive shaft misalignment on agitator A-05
root_cause: Settlement of the tank foundation over time
action_plan: Level the agitator base and perform a precision laser alignment

failure_description: Sudden motor stop on ventilation fan
root_cause: Blown fuse caused by a temporary phase-to-phase short
action_plan: Replace fuse and inspect the motor junction box for moisture

failure_description: Excessive moisture in finished product
root_cause: Drier temperature dropping below the dew point setpoint
action_plan: Inspect drier burners and recalibrate the moisture sensor

failure_description: SCADA system unable to store historical data
root_cause: Log file reached the maximum size limit of 2GB
action_plan: Archive old logs and configure circular logging with larger file limits

failure_description: Worn teeth on planetary gearbox
root_cause: Abrasive wear from metal particles in the lubricant
action_plan: Change gear oil and install a magnetic drain plug to capture particles

failure_description: Emergency light battery failure
root_cause: End of life for lead-acid battery after 3 years
action_plan: Replace all emergency light batteries and schedule annual load tests

failure_description: Short circuit in outdoor junction box
root_cause: Water ingress through a degraded cable gland
action_plan: Replace cable glands with IP68 rated versions and reseal the box

failure_description: Reactor temperature runaway during batch
root_cause: Cooling water valve stuck in the 10% open position
action_plan: Repair the valve positioner and add a bypass cooling line

failure_description: HMI display flickering and losing color
root_cause: Loose VGA/HDMI cable connection at the rear of the panel
action_plan: Secure the cable connections and use locking connectors if available

failure_description: Pump impeller cavitation damage
root_cause: Operating too far to the right of the pump curve
action_plan: Install a flow orifice to maintain backpressure and limit flow

failure_description: Burned out heating element in oven 3
root_cause: Resistive heating wire thinning due to oxidation over time
action_plan: Replace heating elements and inspect the contactor for arcing

failure_description: Inaccurate chemical dosing in Batch B-22
root_cause: Peristaltic pump tube ruptured due to chemical fatigue
action_plan: Implement a proactive tube replacement schedule based on hours

failure_description: Active Directory sync failure
root_cause: DNS record mismatch after a server migration
action_plan: Update DNS records and verify the replication topology

failure_description: Loud grinding noise from conveyor pulley
root_cause: Seized bearing caused by contamination with grit
action_plan: Replace bearing and install a heavy-duty taconite seal

failure_description: Hydraulic cylinder leaking at the rod seal
root_cause: Piston rod scoring caused by airborne particulates
action_plan: Replace seal and install a rod wiper or protective bellow

failure_description: Frequent tripping of the main breaker
root_cause: Harmonic distortion caused by multiple VFDs
action_plan: Install line reactors on the VFDs and perform a power quality audit

failure_description: Product oxidation in storage tank
root_cause: Nitrogen blanket pressure dropping below threshold
action_plan: Repair the nitrogen regulator and install a low-pressure alarm

failure_description: Slow backup speeds to offsite storage
root_cause: ISP bandwidth throttling during business hours
action_plan: Schedule backups for off-peak hours or upgrade the WAN link

failure_description: Air leak at pneumatic manifold
root_cause: O-ring degradation due to high ambient temperature
action_plan: Replace O-rings with high-temperature-rated fluorocarbon material

failure_description: Cracked weld on structural support
root_cause: Vibration-induced fatigue from a nearby vibrating screen
action_plan: Repair the weld and install vibration dampening pads

failure_description: Limit switch failure on overhead crane
root_cause: Physical damage from impact during high-speed operation
action_plan: Relocate the limit switch and install a mechanical hard stop

failure_description: Color variance in plastic extrusion
root_cause: Uneven heating in the extruder barrel zones
action_plan: Check all heater bands and replace those with low resistance

failure_description: Virtual machine failing to start
root_cause: ESXi host ran out of physical memory (RAM)
action_plan: Migrate other VMs to a different host or increase the physical RAM

failure_description: Oil leakage from a distribution transformer
root_cause: Gasket failure on the high-voltage bushing
action_plan: Replace bushing gaskets and top up the insulating oil

failure_description: Broken drive belt on cooling fan
root_cause: Belt slippage caused by oil contamination
action_plan: Clean the pulleys and replace the belt with an oil-resistant type

failure_description: Circuit breaker failing to close
root_cause: Mechanical trip mechanism stuck due to old grease
action_plan: Clean the mechanism and apply a light coating of synthetic grease

failure_description: Inconsistent flow from diaphragm pump
root_cause: Check valve stuck open by a small stone
action_plan: Clean the check valve and install a suction strainer

failure_description: Email server rejecting incoming mail
root_cause: Mailbox database has reached its storage quota
action_plan: Expand the database storage and implement mail archiving

failure_description: Exhaust fan motor running backwards
root_cause: Phase reversal during recent electrical maintenance
action_plan: Swap two phases at the motor terminal to correct the rotation

failure_description: Agitator shaft snapping at the coupling
root_cause: Torsional stress from starting the agitator with solids at bottom
action_plan: Revise startup SOP and ensure the tank is filled before starting

failure_description: Steam leakage from a valve bonnet
root_cause: Packing material dried out and shrunk
action_plan: Tighten the packing nut or replace the valve packing

failure_description: Incorrect data on the production dashboard
root_cause: OPC server lost connection to the field PLC
action_plan: Restart the OPC service and verify the network path

failure_description: Catalyst bed pressure drop increasing
root_cause: Fine particles clogging the catalyst support screen
action_plan: Perform a screen backflush and inspect the feed filter

failure_description: Bearing failure on high-speed blower
root_cause: Improper mounting causing excessive preload
action_plan: Replace bearing and use a precision mounting tool

failure_description: Control cabinet overheating
root_cause: Cabinet cooling fan filter clogged with lint
action_plan: Clean or replace the fan filter and check the thermostat

failure_description: Loss of prime on suction-lift pump
root_cause: Small air leak in the suction pipe joint
action_plan: Tighten all suction joints and apply a thread sealant

failure_description: Printer unable to connect to the print server
root_cause: Stale IP reservation in the DHCP server
action_plan: Release and renew the IP address or update the static reservation

failure_description: Lubricant discoloration in main gearbox
root_cause: High operating temperature causing oil oxidation
action_plan: Check the oil cooler and consider switching to a synthetic oil

failure_description: Conveyor rollers seizing up
root_cause: Dust ingress into the non-sealed bearings
action_plan: Replace rollers with a sealed-for-life bearing type

failure_description: Motor brush sparking on DC motor
root_cause: Worn carbon brushes and dirty commutator
action_plan: Replace brushes and resurface the commutator with a stone

failure_description: pH sensor reading drifting rapidly
root_cause: Reference electrode depletion due to high temperature
action_plan: Replace the pH probe with a high-temperature-grade version

failure_description: Remote desktop connection failing
root_cause: Firewall rule blocking port 3389
action_plan: Allow port 3389 in the Windows firewall and the network gateway

failure_description: Cooling tower fan vibration high
root_cause: Blade pitch misalignment causing aerodynamic imbalance
action_plan: Adjust blade pitch to within 0.5 degrees and rebalance

failure_description: Fuse blowing on 24V DC circuit
root_cause: Short circuit in a solenoid valve coil
action_plan: Replace the solenoid valve and check the wiring for damage

failure_description: Inaccurate gas flow measurement
root_cause: Liquid condensate trapping in the orifice plate impulse lines
action_plan: Install condensate pots and slope the impulse lines correctly

failure_description: Web server returning 502 Bad Gateway
root_cause: Backend application service has crashed
action_plan: Restart the application service and check for memory leaks

failure_description: Oil mist coming from vacuum pump exhaust
root_cause: Exhaust filter element is saturated
action_plan: Replace the exhaust filter and check the oil return line

failure_description: Sheared key on motor drive shaft
root_cause: Shock loading during a mechanical jam
action_plan: Replace the key and install a shear pin coupling for protection

failure_description: Proximity sensor failing to detect targets
root_cause: Sensor head covered in metallic dust
action_plan: Clean the sensor head and install a protective shield

failure_description: Unstable flame in the furnace
root_cause: Fluctuating fuel gas pressure from the main header
action_plan: Install a local pressure regulator for the furnace burners

failure_description: SCADA client losing connection frequently
root_cause: Weak Wi-Fi signal in the operator area
action_plan: Install an additional Wi-Fi access point or use a wired connection

failure_description: Leaking flange on high-pressure steam line
root_cause: Bolts loosened due to thermal expansion and contraction
action_plan: Perform a hot torque of the flange bolts

failure_description: Broken spring on a safety relief valve
root_cause: Stress corrosion cracking in a sour gas environment
action_plan: Replace spring with an Inconel material suitable for H2S

failure_description: Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) trip on undervoltage
root_cause: Large motor start-up on the same bus causing a voltage dip
action_plan: Install a soft starter on the large motor or increase the VFD bus capacitance

failure_description: Inconsistent product color from the mixer
root_cause: Mixing time too short for the specific pigment type
action_plan: Increase the mixing time and verify the impeller speed

failure_description: Active Directory user lockout issues
root_cause: Automated script using an old password
action_plan: Identify the script source and update the stored credentials

failure_description: Loose foundation bolts on a reciprocating compressor
root_cause: Inadequate tightening during the last overhaul
action_plan: Retighten bolts to the correct torque and use lock nuts

failure_description: Fatigue crack in a centrifugal fan scroll
root_cause: Acoustic resonance within the fan housing
action_plan: Stiffen the housing with external ribs to change the resonant frequency

failure_description: Corroded busbars in an outdoor MCC
root_cause: Moisture ingress and lack of space heaters
action_plan: Install cabinet space heaters and apply a protective coating to the busbars

failure_description: Filter cloth tearing in the belt press
root_cause: Excessive tension applied to the tracking rollers
action_plan: Adjust the tracking sensor and reduce the pneumatic tension pressure

failure_description: DNS resolution failing for internal sites
root_cause: Primary DNS server service is unresponsive
action_plan: Restart the DNS service and check the secondary server sync

failure_description: Grease leakage from a motor bearing
root_cause: Over-greasing causing the seal to pop out
action_plan: Follow the manufacturer's grease volume guidelines

failure_description: Bearing housing overheating
root_cause: Excessive grease volume causing churning
action_plan: Remove the grease relief plug and allow excess grease to escape

failure_description: Ground fault trip on a submersible pump
root_cause: Cable insulation damaged by abrasion against the well casing
action_plan: Replace the cable and use cable protectors/centralizers

failure_description: Loss of vacuum in a condenser
root_cause: Air ingress through a leaking gland on the condensate pump
action_plan: Repair the pump gland and perform a helium leak test on the condenser

failure_description: Slow application performance for remote users
root_cause: High latency on the VPN tunnel
action_plan: Optimize the VPN encryption settings or use a split-tunneling policy

failure_description: Noisy operation of a hydraulic gear pump
root_cause: Air entering the suction line through a loose fitting
action_plan: Tighten the suction fitting and inspect the suction hose for cracks

failure_description: Broken teeth on a plastic drive gear
root_cause: Operation at temperatures exceeding the material's limit
action_plan: Replace with a metal gear or improve the local cooling

failure_description: Intermittent failure of an infrared sensor
root_cause: Ambient light interference from a nearby window
action_plan: Install an optical filter or shield the sensor from direct sunlight

failure_description: Product contamination with metal shavings
root_cause: Internal wear of a rotary valve
action_plan: Replace the rotary valve rotor and implement a magnetic separator

failure_description: Unable to access the network file share
root_cause: Permissions were changed during a security audit
action_plan: Restore the correct NTFS and Share permissions

failure_description: Steam trap failing in the closed position
root_cause: Internal orifice blocked by pipe scale and rust
action_plan: Clean the steam trap and install a strainer upstream

failure_description: Cracked pulley on a belt drive
root_cause: Inproper installation using a hammer instead of a puller
action_plan: Replace the pulley and use the correct tools for installation

failure_description: Electric motor running on two phases
root_cause: One phase lost due to a loose terminal in the MCC
action_plan: Clean and tighten the terminal connections in the MCC

failure_description: Inaccurate temperature reading from a thermocouple
root_cause: Extension wire made of a different material than the thermocouple
action_plan: Replace the extension wire with the correct compensating cable

failure_description: Antivirus software slowing down the HMI
root_cause: Scanning of real-time database files
action_plan: Exclude the SCADA database folders from the real-time scan

failure_description: Oil leak from a hydraulic hose crimp
root_cause: Hose was not fully inserted into the fitting before crimping
action_plan: Replace the hose assembly with a properly crimped one

failure_description: Vibration in a vertical turbine pump
root_cause: Operating too close to the first critical speed
action_plan: Change the pump speed or stiffen the motor support structure

failure_description: Burnt out solenoid valve coil
root_cause: Voltage surge from a nearby lightning strike
action_plan: Replace the coil and install a surge suppressor

failure_description: High turbidity in the treated water
root_cause: Inadequate flocculant dosing due to a pump blockage
action_plan: Clean the dosing pump and recalibrate the stroke length

failure_description: Server failing to boot after a power outage
root_cause: Corrupted boot sector on the system drive
action_plan: Repair the boot sector using the OS recovery environment

failure_description: Leakage at a pipe union
root_cause: Worn seating surfaces due to frequent disassembly
action_plan: Replace the union and use a pipe sealant

failure_description: Worn chain on a bucket elevator
root_cause: Normal wear from handling abrasive materials
action_plan: Replace the chain and install a dry film lubricant system

failure_description: PLC output module failing frequently
root_cause: Inductive kickback from a DC solenoid without a diode
action_plan: Install a flyback diode across the solenoid coil

failure_description: Incorrect chemical concentration in a tank
root_cause: Failure of the concentration analyzer probe
action_plan: Clean and recalibrate the analyzer probe or replace the membrane

failure_description: Data corruption in the historian database
root_cause: Unscheduled server shutdown during a write operation
action_plan: Perform a database repair and ensure the UPS is functional

failure_description: Air compressor relief valve popping frequently
root_cause: Pressure switch setpoint drifting upwards
action_plan: Recalibrate the pressure switch and test the relief valve

failure_description: Broken shaft on a small cooling fan
root_cause: Imbalance caused by dust accumulation on the blades
action_plan: Replace the fan and implement a quarterly cleaning schedule

failure_description: Arcing in a high-voltage switchgear
root_cause: Partial discharge due to dust and moisture on insulators
action_plan: Perform a professional cleaning and an ultrasonic discharge test

failure_description: Product overflow from a hopper
root_cause: High-level switch failed to stop the conveyor
action_plan: Replace the level switch and add a secondary backup sensor

failure_description: SSL certificate expiration error
root_cause: Certificate was not renewed before the deadline
action_plan: Renew the SSL certificate and set up automated reminders

failure_description: Loosened coupling bolts
root_cause: Lack of thread-locking compound
action_plan: Clean the threads and apply a medium-strength thread locker

failure_description: Excessive noise from a centrifugal fan
root_cause: Loose fan wheel on the shaft
action_plan: Tighten the set screws and check the keyway for wear

failure_description: Inaccurate current reading on an ammeter
root_cause: Current transformer (CT) ratio misconfigured in the meter
action_plan: Correct the CT ratio settings in the digital meter

failure_description: Pump failing to meet the required head
root_cause: Internal recirculation due to a worn wear ring
action_plan: Replace the pump wear rings to restore efficiency

failure_description: Backup job failing with 'Media Not Found'
root_cause: Tape drive failure or dirty read/write heads
action_plan: Clean the tape drive heads or replace the drive unit

failure_description: Leaking gasket on a heat exchanger
root_cause: Non-uniform tightening of the bolts
action_plan: Replace the gasket and use a cross-pattern torquing sequence

failure_description: Broken valve stem on a manual gate valve
root_cause: Excessive force used to close a stuck valve
action_plan: Replace the valve and implement a 'no-cheater-bar' policy

failure_description: Intermittent PLC communication error
root_cause: EMI noise on the communication cable from a VFD
action_plan: Use a shielded communication cable and route it away from power lines

failure_description: High iron content in the process water
root_cause: Internal corrosion of the carbon steel piping
action_plan: Replace critical piping with stainless steel or add a corrosion inhibitor

failure_description: Operator unable to log into the SCADA system
root_cause: User account was locked after too many failed attempts
action_plan: Unlock the account and verify the user's password

failure_description: Slow air leak from a pneumatic fitting
root_cause: Damaged thread on the fitting
action_plan: Replace the fitting and use a high-quality thread tape

failure_description: Cracked housing on a small gearbox
root_cause: Internal pressure buildup due to a blocked breather
action_plan: Replace the gearbox and clean the breather vent

failure_description: Indicator lamp not working on the panel
root_cause: Blown incandescent bulb
action_plan: Replace the bulb with a long-life LED version

failure_description: Inconsistent batch quality
root_cause: Variations in the raw material moisture content
action_plan: Install an inline moisture analyzer for the raw material feed

failure_description: Historian server disk space low
root_cause: Automatic compression of old data is not working
action_plan: Enable data compression and move old files to a NAS

failure_description: Oil leakage from a pump bearing housing
root_cause: Oil level too high causing it to leak from the seals
action_plan: Adjust the oil level to the center of the sight glass

failure_description: Vibration in a cooling water pipe
root_cause: Lack of proper pipe supports and bracing
action_plan: Install additional pipe hangers and vibration dampeners

failure_description: Temperature transmitter reading 'Off Scale High'
root_cause: Open circuit in the RTD sensor or wiring
action_plan: Check the RTD for continuity and replace if the circuit is open

failure_description: Sudden drop in reactor pressure
root_cause: Rupture disk failed prematurely due to fatigue
action_plan: Replace the rupture disk and investigate the pressure cycling

failure_description: Application timeout for database queries
root_cause: Database statistics are outdated, causing poor query plans
action_plan: Update the database statistics and rebuild fragmented indexes

failure_description: Worn belts on a motor drive
root_cause: Pulley misalignment causing side-wear on the belts
action_plan: Align the pulleys and adjust the belt tension

failure_description: Bearing failure on a screw conveyor
root_cause: Product ingress into the bearing housing
action_plan: Replace the bearing and upgrade to a triple-lip seal

failure_description: Control signal fluctuation (4-20mA)
root_cause: Signal wire insulation damaged and touching the conduit
action_plan: Identify the damaged wire section and replace it

failure_description: Inaccurate level reading in a foaming liquid
root_cause: Ultrasonic sensor reflected by foam instead of liquid
action_plan: Switch to a guided wave radar sensor for better foam penetration

failure_description: Firewall blocking a new industrial protocol
root_cause: Protocol port not allowed in the security policy
action_plan: Add a rule to allow the specific industrial protocol (e.g., Modbus TCP)

failure_description: Clogged grease lines on an auto-lube system
root_cause: Grease separated and hardened over time
action_plan: Flush the lines and use a higher-quality synthetic grease

failure_description: Broken teeth on a timing belt
root_cause: Belt over-tightened during installation
action_plan: Replace the belt and use a tension gauge for setting

failure_description: Intermittent trip of a safety relay
root_cause: Faulty E-stop button contact block
action_plan: Replace the E-stop button and verify the wiring continuity

failure_description: Product contamination with hydraulic oil
root_cause: Hose rupture inside the process area
action_plan: Replace the hose and install a protective sleeve

failure_description: SCADA trends showing 'No Data' gaps
root_cause: Network congestion causing data packet loss
action_plan: Optimize the network traffic and check for faulty cables

failure_description: Valve stem leakage on a control valve
root_cause: Worn-out stem packing due to high cycle count
action_plan: Replace the packing and inspect the stem for scratches

failure_description: High motor vibration at specific speeds
root_cause: Resonance at the motor's natural frequency
action_plan: Program a 'skip frequency' in the VFD to avoid that speed

failure_description: Panel meter reading zero for voltage
root_cause: Blown potential transformer (PT) fuse
action_plan: Replace the PT fuse and check for downstream shorts

failure_description: Inaccurate weight from a belt scale
root_cause: Material buildup on the weighing idler
action_plan: Clean the idler and implement a daily inspection

failure_description: SQL Server service unable to start
root_cause: Service account password has expired
action_plan: Update the service account password and set it to never expire

failure_description: Steam leakage from a turbine casing
root_cause: Thermal distortion of the casing over time
action_plan: Perform casing machining and use a high-temperature sealant

failure_description: Broken motor mount on a small pump
root_cause: Vibration-induced fatigue on the cast iron mount
action_plan: Replace the mount and install vibration isolation pads

failure_description: Ground fault on a heat-tracing cable
root_cause: Cable damaged by physical impact during maintenance
action_plan: Identify the fault location and repair using a splice kit

failure_description: Inconsistent flow from a control valve
root_cause: Valve plug eroded by high-velocity slurry
action_plan: Replace the valve trim with a hardened material like Stellite

failure_description: HMI screen has permanent 'burn-in' images
root_cause: Screen left on the same static page for too long
action_plan: Replace the HMI and configure a screen saver or auto-dim

failure_description: Leaking seal on a rotary lobe pump
root_cause: Abrasive particles in the fluid damaging the seal faces
action_plan: Replace the seal and install a hard-face material (e.g., Tungsten Carbide)
